name: Gigimon
text: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, this Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn.

name: Agumon
text: [When Attacking] When this Digimon attacks a player, it gets +2000 DP for the turn.

name: Guilmon
text: [Your Turn] If your opponent has a level 6 or higher Digimon in play, this Digimon can digivolve into a [Gallantmon] in your hand for a memory cost of 4, ignoring its digivolution requirements.
[Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, trigger ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)

name: Biyomon
text: ＜Blocker＞ (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead.)[Your Turn] This Digimon can't attack players.

name: Growlmon
text: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, gain 1 memory.

name: GeoGreymon
text: [Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying its memory cost.[On Play] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.

name: RizeGreymon
text: [On Play] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less.

name: WarGrowlmon
text: [When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
[Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, this Digimon gains ＜Security Attack +1＞ for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)

name: Gallantmon
text: ＜Security Attack +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)[When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less. If no Digimon was deleted by this effect, this Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn.

name: ShineGreymon
text: ＜Security Attack +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)

name: Lightning Joust
text: [Main] 1 of your Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn. Then, if the number of cards in your security stack is less than or equal to your opponent's, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Security Attack +1＞ for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.

name: Atomic Blaster
text: [Main] Choose any number of your opponent's Digimon whose total DP adds up to 8000 or less and delete them.
